import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import App from '@src/response-apps/shop/playerShop/rename/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

/**
 * 命名店铺指令
 * - 指令格式：/命名店铺 新名字
 */
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const text = (e.MessageText ?? '').trim();
  const m = text.match(/命名店铺\s+(.+)/);

  if (!m?.[1]?.trim()) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('请输入店铺名称：/命名店铺 名字');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('名称2-12个字，不能包含特殊字符'));

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '命名店铺',
        content: md,
        footer: [{ label: '我的小店', command: '/我的小店' }]
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  const newName = m[1].trim();

  const request = createBackendRequestContext(e);

  try {
    const result = await App({ messageText: e.MessageText, bid, uid, newName, request });

    if (result.code === 'LOAD_FAILED') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(result.data.message);

      void message.send(
        FormatGui({
          isPrivate,
          bid,
          title: '命名店铺',
          content: md,
          footer: [{ label: '我的小店', command: '/我的小店' }]
        })
      );

      return;
    }

    const md = Format.createMarkdown();
    const displayMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, e.MessageText, result.data.message, request);

    md.addText(displayMsg);

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '命名店铺',
        content: md,
        footer: [
          { label: '我的小店', command: '/我的小店' },
          { label: '小店列表', command: '/小店' }
        ]
      })
    );
  } catch {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('命名失败，请稍后再试');

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '命名店铺',
        content: md,
        footer: [{ label: '我的小店', command: '/我的小店' }]
      })
    );
  }
});
